policy: Platform project. The solver fork is shared and pinned; every run records the commit it used. No absolute path is tracked in this repository: solver roots are repository-relative or come from the environment (PARITY_SOLVER_ROOT, PARITY_SOLVER_UPSTREAM).

upstream.role: FROZEN PROVENANCE. Never modified, never dirty, never advanced. Every run copies the solver source into runs/<id>/snapshot/, so provenance survives independently of the path.

fork.role: OUR WORKING SOLVER. It may move. Reproducibility comes from recording, not from forbidding: each run writes the fork commit and the dirty count into its own manifest and snapshot.
